verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from a user's case or alert data inside Hummingbird. The homepage mentions agents automating routine work and dispositioning alerts "more intelligently" with customizable automation, but this is vague marketing about automation, an adjacent capability rather than in-product AI insights. The remaining docs cover APIs, attachments, filings, workflows and exports, none of which address the story.
